scope: Frozen v57 staged handoff subset dimensions only;57 replacement/addition assets, not the full162-role package. Every handoff/metadata SHA is checked. PNG IHDR matches each descriptor; full PNG byte integrity is inherited from handoff and not rechecked here. No decoding, renderer, browser or GPU measurement.
limits: All-pages bytes are a storage residency ceiling for this subset, not expected simultaneous usage.
Idle d00_f00 pages are a hypothetical union; absent idle states are not included, fallback/aliases and multi-frame/direction animation may admit more.
A GPU allocation and a decoded source may coexist; residentBytes counts nominal RGBA once.
Picking masks count one bit per beauty/team pixel; temporary getImageData RGBA/canvas and source bitmap are excluded.
